q19015.en: With the sign shown, you must drive as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway, on a road with only two lanes and two-way traffic.

explain.short: In bends you cannot see far ahead, so you keep well to the right to leave room for oncoming cars.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'il più vicino possibile' (as close as possible) is correct here: in bends you hug the right edge.

sceneParams.caption: Two bends: keep close to the right edge

q19016.en: With the sign shown, you must adjust your speed to the visibility and to the radius of the bends.

explain.short: Tight bends and short visibility need a lower speed, so you can stop in time.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'raggio delle curve' (radius of the bends): a tighter bend means a slower speed.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down for visibility and tight bends

q19017.en: With the sign shown, you must take the bends with more care when it rains.

explain.short: Rain makes the road slippery, and in a bend the tyres can lose grip more easily.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'in caso di pioggia' (when it rains): rain is a reason for extra care, so this is right.

q19018.en: With the sign shown, you must adjust your speed to how loaded the vehicle is.

explain.short: A heavy load makes the vehicle less stable and slower to brake in the bends.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'condizioni di carico' (load): the load changes how the vehicle behaves in a bend.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy load: take the bends slower

q19019.en: With the sign shown, you may not overtake on roads with only two lanes and two-way traffic.

explain.short: In bends you cannot see oncoming traffic, so overtaking on a two-lane two-way road is forbidden.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' (is not allowed): here the ban is correct.

q19020.en: With the sign shown, it is advisable to pay special attention to vehicles coming from the opposite direction.

explain.short: An oncoming car may appear suddenly in a bend, or even cut the bend.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'senso opposto' (opposite direction): the danger also comes from the front.

sceneParams.caption: Watch for cars coming the other way

q19021.en: With the sign shown, a U-turn is allowed.

explain.short: Turning round in a bend is forbidden: other drivers cannot see you in time.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'consentita' (allowed) is the trap: a U-turn near bends is forbidden.

q19022.en: With the sign shown, placed on two-lane two-way roads, you may overtake a very slow vehicle.

explain.short: The ban on overtaking in bends applies to every vehicle, even a very slow one.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'molto lento' (very slow): the speed of the other vehicle does not change the ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no overtaking, even slow vehicles

q19023.en: With the sign shown, reversing is allowed.

explain.short: Reversing in a bend is forbidden: drivers behind cannot see you.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'consentita' (allowed) is the trap: reversing in bends is forbidden.

q19024.en: With the sign shown, you need to keep a moderate speed only in the first bend.

explain.short: There are two bends, so you keep a moderate speed in both of them.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'esclusivamente' (only) is the trap: the second bend is dangerous too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: slow down in BOTH bends

q19025.en: With the sign shown, stopping briefly in the bends is allowed.

explain.short: Stopping in a bend is forbidden: a car stopped there is a hidden obstacle.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'fermata' (a brief stop) is forbidden in bends too, not only parking.

q19026.en: With the sign shown, you may overtake motorcycles and mopeds on two-lane two-way roads.

explain.short: The ban on overtaking in bends applies to all vehicles, motorbikes and mopeds included.
explain.rule: Two bends ahead, the first to the left: slow down, keep right, and do not overtake, turn round, reverse or stop in the bends.
explain.trap: 'motocicli e ciclomotori' (motorcycles and mopeds): small vehicles are not an exception.

q19027.en: The sign shown warns of a level crossing with barriers or half-barriers.

explain.short: The fence symbol means a railway crossing closed by barriers or half-barriers.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'barriere o semibarriere' (barriers or half-barriers): this sign covers both.

q19028.en: After the sign shown, if there are half-barriers, a device with flashing red lights is installed.

explain.short: Half-barriers always come with flashing red lights that warn when a train is coming.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'semibarriere' goes with 'luci rosse lampeggianti' (flashing red lights).

q19029.en: The sign shown warns of a railway crossing protected by barriers or half-barriers, whatever the number of tracks.

explain.short: The same sign is used whether there is one track or many.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'qualunque sia il numero dei binari' (whatever the number of tracks): the number of tracks does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Barriers sign: any number of tracks

keywords.it: qualunque sia il numero dei binari

q19030.en: The sign shown warns of a railway crossing fitted with barriers or half-barriers.

explain.short: The fence symbol stands for a railway crossing that can be closed by barriers.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'munito di' (fitted with) means it has barriers: correct for this sign.

q19031.en: After the sign shown, there may be a sound device that warns that the barriers or half-barriers are closing.

explain.short: Many level crossings have a bell or buzzer that sounds while the barriers come down.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'si può trovare' (there may be): it is possible, not always there.

sceneParams.caption: A sound signal may warn of closing

q19032.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, placed 150 metres before the level crossing.

explain.short: Like most danger signs outside towns, it stands about 150 m before the crossing.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) and '150 metri': this is the normal distance.

sceneParams.caption: As a rule 150 m before the crossing

q19033.en: With the sign shown, you must reduce your speed.

explain.short: A level crossing is a danger: you slow down so you can stop if it is closing.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'moderare' (reduce): every danger sign asks you to slow down.

q19034.en: After the sign shown, if there are barriers, a device with a steady red light is installed.

explain.short: Full barriers come with a steady red light that tells you to stop.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'luce rossa fissa' (steady red light) goes with full barriers; flashing lights go with half-barriers.

q19035.en: The picture shows a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a red-edged triangle with the point up: that shape always means danger.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger): the triangle shape tells you the type of sign.

q19036.en: The sign shown warns of a crossing with a tram line.

explain.short: The fence means a railway crossing with barriers; trams have a different sign.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'tranviaria' (tram) is the trap: the fence is for trains, not trams.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: barriers for trains, not trams

q19037.en: The sign shown warns of a dead-end road.

explain.short: The fence means a level crossing with barriers, not a road with no way out.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'senza uscita' (dead end) is the trap: a dead end has a square blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: level crossing, not a dead end

q19038.en: The sign shown makes you stop if the red lights near the barriers or half-barriers are off.

explain.short: You must stop when the red lights are ON (flashing); when they are off you may pass with care.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'spente' (off) is the trap: the stop order is for lights that are switched on.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: stop when the red lights are ON

q19039.en: The sign shown shows a compulsory detour.

explain.short: The fence means a level crossing ahead; it gives no order to change direction.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'deviazione obbligatoria' (compulsory detour) is the trap: this is a danger sign, not an order.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a warning, not a detour

q19040.en: The sign shown lets you drive between one bar and the other when the half-barriers are closed, after checking that no trains are coming.

explain.short: Closed half-barriers mean stop: zigzagging between them is never allowed.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'dopo aver verificato' (after checking) is the trap: checking does not make it legal.

keywords.it: transitare tra una barra e l'altra
keywords.en: drive between one bar and the other

q19041.en: The sign shown shows a guarded parking area.

explain.short: The fence means a level crossing with barriers, not a car park.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'area di sosta custodita' (guarded parking) is the trap: parking signs are blue squares.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: level crossing, not a car park

q19042.en: The sign shown comes before the vertical sign DOUBLE ST ANDREW'S CROSS.

explain.short: St Andrew's crosses are used at crossings WITHOUT barriers; here there are barriers.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'DOPPIA CROCE DI S. ANDREA' is the trap: it belongs to crossings without barriers.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no St Andrew's cross with barriers

q19043.en: The sign shown warns of fence barriers around roadworks.

explain.short: The fence picture means a railway crossing with barriers, not a building site.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'cantiere stradale' (roadworks) is the trap: roadworks have their own sign with a worker.

q19044.en: The sign shown requires you to give way to prison police vehicles coming out of prisons.

explain.short: The fence has nothing to do with prisons: it warns of a level crossing with barriers.
explain.rule: The fence sign warns of a level crossing (passaggio a livello) with barriers or half-barriers, as a rule 150 m before it.
explain.trap: 'carceri' (prisons) is a silly trap: the bars are a railway gate, not prison bars.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: railway gate, not prison bars

q19045.en: With the sign shown, you must reduce your speed so that you are ready to stop if the barriers are closed.

explain.short: You slow down early so you can stop safely if the barriers are down.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'pronti ad arrestarsi' (ready to stop): this is exactly why you slow down.

q19046.en: With the sign shown, you may not go onto the level crossing if heavy traffic stops you from clearing it.

explain.short: If traffic ahead is stuck, you could be trapped on the tracks: wait before the crossing.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'sgomberarlo' (to clear it): you enter only if you can get off the other side.

sceneParams.caption: Don't enter if you can't get across

q19047.en: With the sign shown, you must stop if the two flashing red lights are working.

explain.short: Flashing red lights mean a train is coming and the barriers are closing: stop.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'in funzione' (working): lights ON means stop.

q19048.en: With the sign shown, you must stop if the sound device warning that the barriers are closing is working.

explain.short: The sound means the barriers are coming down: stop and wait.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'in funzione' (working): the sound signal ON means stop.

q19049.en: With the sign shown, if the vehicle breaks down on the tracks, the driver must take every useful step to avoid accidents.

explain.short: A car stuck on the tracks is very dangerous: get people out, warn others and try to stop the train.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'ogni iniziativa utile' (every useful step): the driver must act, not just wait.

sceneParams.caption: Stuck on the tracks: act to avoid a crash

q19050.en: With the sign shown, parking is allowed on or near level crossings.

explain.short: Parking on or near a level crossing is always forbidden.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'consentito' (allowed) is the trap: parking there is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no parking near level crossings

q19051.en: With the sign shown, you need to slow down only when visibility is poor.

explain.short: You always slow down at a level crossing, whatever the visibility.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: slowing down is always required.

q19052.en: With the sign shown, you may cross the tracks if they are blocked by red-and-white striped trestles.

explain.short: Red-and-white trestles close the crossing: you must not go over the tracks.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'possibile' (possible) is the trap: trestles mean the way is closed.

q19053.en: With the sign shown, a brief stop is allowed but not parking, on or near the tracks.

explain.short: Near the tracks both a brief stop and parking are forbidden.
explain.rule: At a crossing with barriers, slow down, stop when lights flash or the sound works, and never stop or park near the tracks.
explain.trap: 'la fermata ma non la sosta' is the trap: the brief stop is forbidden too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no stopping AND no parking

q19054.en: The sign shown warns of a railway crossing at road level without barriers.

explain.short: The steam train means a level crossing with no barriers: nothing will close the road.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'senza barriere' (without barriers): train picture = no barriers; fence picture = barriers.

q19055.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, placed 150 metres from the tracks, together with its distance panel.

explain.short: It stands about 150 m before the tracks, above the panel with the red bars.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'pannello distanziometrico' (distance panel): the panel shows how far the tracks are.

sceneParams.caption: 150 m before, with the distance panel

q19056.en: The sign shown requires you to use the greatest care.

explain.short: With no barriers, only your own care protects you from a train.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'massima prudenza' (greatest care): right, there is no barrier to stop you.

q19057.en: The picture shows a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a red-edged triangle with the point up: a danger sign.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger): the triangle shape tells you the type of sign.

q19058.en: After the sign shown, there is the ST ANDREW'S CROSS sign, placed before the tracks.

explain.short: At a crossing without barriers, a St Andrew's cross stands right before the tracks.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'CROCE DI S. ANDREA' belongs to crossings WITHOUT barriers: correct here.

sceneParams.caption: Then a St Andrew's cross at the tracks

q19059.en: The sign shown is completed by the distance panel with three red bars.

explain.short: The three-bar panel means about 150 m to the tracks, and this sign stands on it.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'tre barre rosse' (three red bars): the first panel, the farthest from the tracks.

sceneParams.caption: On the panel with three red bars

q19060.en: After the sign shown, the DOUBLE ST ANDREW'S CROSS sign is installed if the railway line has more than one track.

explain.short: The double cross tells you there are two or more tracks to cross.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'più di un binario' (more than one track): double cross = more tracks.

sceneParams.caption: More tracks: double St Andrew's cross

q19061.en: The sign shown shows a crossing with a tram line.

explain.short: The steam train means a railway crossing without barriers; trams have their own sign.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'tranviaria' (tram) is the trap: the train picture is for railways.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a train, not a tram

q19062.en: The sign shown warns of a railway crossing at road level fitted with half-barriers.

explain.short: The steam train means NO barriers at all; half-barriers use the fence sign.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'semibarriere' (half-barriers) is the trap: this crossing has none.

q19063.en: The sign shown is placed on the second distance panel with red bars.

explain.short: This sign stands on the FIRST panel, the one with three bars at about 150 m.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'secondo' (second) is the trap: the second panel (two bars) has no triangle on top.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is on the 3-bar panel

q19064.en: The sign shown warns of a level crossing with barriers.

explain.short: The steam train means a crossing WITHOUT barriers; with barriers you see a fence.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'con barriere' (with barriers) is the trap: train = no barriers.

q19065.en: The sign shown shows a railway station 150 metres ahead.

explain.short: It warns of tracks to cross, not of a station.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'stazione ferroviaria' (station) is the trap: the train means a crossing.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a crossing, not a station

q19066.en: The sign shown can be completed by a panel with the word TRAM.

explain.short: This sign is for railway crossings only; trams have a different danger sign.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'TRAM' is the trap: no tram panel goes with the steam train.

q19067.en: The picture shows a priority sign.

explain.short: It is a danger sign (red triangle, point up), not a priority sign.
explain.rule: The steam train warns of a level crossing without barriers, as a rule 150 m before, on the three-bar panel.
explain.trap: 'precedenza' (priority) is the trap: the triangle with a picture inside means danger.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a danger sign

q19068.en: With the sign shown, you must slow down according to how well you can see the railway line.

explain.short: If you cannot see far along the tracks, you must go slower to spot a train in time.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'visibilità della linea ferroviaria' (visibility of the railway): less view, less speed.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down to see along the railway

q19069.en: With the sign shown, you must use the greatest care.

explain.short: No barrier will stop you, so you must be very careful yourself.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'massima prudenza' (greatest care): right at a crossing without barriers.

q19070.en: With the sign shown, you must slow down so that you can, if needed, stop the vehicle before the railway crossing.

explain.short: You slow down so you can stop before the tracks if a train is coming.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'eventualmente' (if needed): be ready to stop, not always stop.

q19071.en: With the sign shown, before crossing you must make sure no trains are coming from either the right or the left.

explain.short: Without barriers you check both ways yourself before going over the tracks.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'sia da destra che da sinistra' (from both right and left): check both sides.

sceneParams.caption: Look left AND right for trains

keywords.it: sia da destra che da sinistra

q19072.en: With the sign shown, you may not park or stop near or on the tracks.

explain.short: A stopped car near the tracks blocks the way and can be hit by a train.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' (not allowed): both stopping and parking are banned, correct.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping or parking near tracks

q19073.en: With the sign shown, you need to slow down only in fog.

explain.short: You always slow down at a crossing without barriers, not only in fog.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'esclusivamente' (only) is the trap: slowing down is always needed.

q19074.en: With the sign shown, you must stop before the tracks if the light or sound signals are not working.

explain.short: You must stop when the lights or sound ARE working, because a train is coming; when they are off, you pass carefully.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'non sono in funzione' (not working) is the trap: the stop is for signals that are on.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: stop when signals ARE on

q19075.en: With the sign shown, you may cross the tracks if they are blocked by red-and-white striped trestles.

explain.short: Red-and-white trestles close the crossing: you must not go over the tracks.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'possibile' (possible) is the trap: trestles mean the way is closed.

q19076.en: With the sign shown, you must use the horn before crossing the tracks.

explain.short: The horn is not required here: the train cannot stop for you anyway. You look and listen.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' (compulsory) is the trap: no rule makes you honk here.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the horn is not compulsory

q19077.en: With the sign shown, overtaking by going into the opposite lane is allowed.

explain.short: Near a level crossing without barriers, overtaking is forbidden.
explain.rule: At a crossing without barriers, use the greatest care: slow down, be ready to stop and look both ways for trains.
explain.trap: 'consentito' (allowed) is the trap: you may not move into the other lane to overtake here.

q19078.en: The sign shown says that the railway has only one track.

explain.short: A single St Andrew's cross means one track; the double cross means more tracks.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'un solo binario' (only one track): single cross = one track.

q19079.en: The sign shown is placed right next to a railway crossing without barriers.

explain.short: St Andrew's crosses stand right at crossings that have no barriers.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'senza barriere' (without barriers): this cross is used only where there are none.

q19080.en: The sign shown is placed right next to the track.

explain.short: The cross is the last sign before the train track, very close to it.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'immediate vicinanze' (right next to): it is at the tracks, not 150 m away.

q19081.en: The sign shown is placed on the road after the LEVEL CROSSING WITHOUT BARRIERS sign.

explain.short: First you meet the train sign 150 m before, then the cross at the tracks.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'dopo' (after): the cross comes after the triangle with the train.

sceneParams.caption: Cross comes AFTER the train sign

q19082.en: The picture shows a danger sign.

explain.short: Even though it is not a triangle, the St Andrew's cross is a danger sign.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger): the cross is a danger sign despite its unusual shape.

q19083.en: The sign shown can be placed either horizontally or vertically.

explain.short: The cross can be fixed in either position, so you must know it both ways.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'sia ... che' (both ... and): both positions are allowed.

q19084.en: The sign shown warns of a railway with more than one track.

explain.short: The single cross means ONE track; more tracks need the double cross.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'più binari' (more tracks) is the trap: that is the double cross.

q19085.en: The sign shown warns of a junction of four roads.

explain.short: The X shape is a railway cross, not a crossroads sign.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'incrocio di quattro strade' (four-way junction) is the trap: the X means a railway.

q19086.en: The sign shown warns of a tram line with only one track.

explain.short: The St Andrew's cross is for railways, not for trams.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'tranviaria' (tram) is the trap: one track yes, but for trains.

q19087.en: The sign shown is installed near a level crossing with half-barriers.

explain.short: The cross is used at crossings WITHOUT barriers or half-barriers.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'semibarriere' (half-barriers) is the trap: the cross means no barriers.

q19088.en: The sign shown is placed before the LEVEL CROSSING WITHOUT BARRIERS sign.

explain.short: The order is the opposite: first the train sign, then the cross at the tracks.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'prima' (before) is the trap: the cross comes AFTER.

q19089.en: The sign shown is completed by a green light and a steady red light.

explain.short: The cross can have flashing red lights, never a green light.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: 'luce verde' (green light) is the trap: no green light goes with this cross.

q19090.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, located 150 metres from the tracks.

explain.short: The cross stands right next to the tracks; the 150 m sign is the triangle with the train.
explain.rule: The single St Andrew's cross stands right next to a one-track crossing without barriers.
explain.trap: '150 metri' is the trap: that distance belongs to the triangle, not to the cross.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is at the tracks, not 150 m
